name: voronoi-cells
prompt: Animated Voronoi cells with dark borders, like cracked glass. Cell scale and border width as sliders.

provenance.via: claude --print with the in-app agent instructions (no Powermove MCP tools)

summary: I wrote a cracked-glass shader layer: moving Voronoi cells with dark borders, using `uScale` for cell scale and `uBorder` for border width. It hasn't been compiled or rendered because no live Powermove tools were attached. `uSpeed`, `uTint` (shard colour) and `uEdge` (border colour) are also exposed as controls.
